title: ST Icons
summary: An icon library for Atari ST emulation under Windows 95. 32×32 and 16×16, 16-colour icons for use with PaCifiST (and later bundled with Fuji Bar!). A .reg file assigns the right icons to TOS programs and .st / .msa disk images if you copy the library into C:\Windows\ . Archived page: gingerbeardman.com/archive/tektonix/icons.htm
content:
An icon library for Atari ST emulation under Windows 95. 32×32 and 16×16, 16-colour icons for use with PaCifiST (and later bundled with Fuji Bar!). A .reg file assigns the right icons to TOS programs and .st / .msa disk images if you copy the library into C:\Windows\.

Archived page: gingerbeardman.com/archive/tektonix/icons.htm
